# Catalog Consistency Checklist: Room Management

**Purpose**: Validate that the three parallel administrator-managed catalogs introduced/extended
in this spec — Equipment Type, Building, and Floor — are specified completely, clearly, and
consistently with each other, since they follow the same create/rename/deactivate/reactivate/delete
pattern but were authored at different times (Equipment Type at initial spec, Building/Floor added
via a later change request).
**Created**: 2026-09-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Do FR-014, FR-018, and FR-019 each explicitly state the default status of a newly created equipment type, building, or floor, respectively, the way FR-001 does for a newly created room? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-001, FR-014, FR-018, FR-019]
- [x] CHK002 - Is a non-empty-name validation rule explicitly stated for equipment type, building, and floor names, the way FR-007 states it for room/seating-arrangement names? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-007, FR-014, FR-018, FR-019]
- [x] CHK003 - Is there a requirement governing whether *renaming* an existing equipment type, building, or floor is checked against the same uniqueness rule that FR-023 applies at creation time? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK004 - Is the equipment-type name uniqueness rule stated as an explicit functional requirement (mirroring FR-023 for buildings/floors), or does it only appear in `data-model.md`? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-014-FR-017 vs data-model.md]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK005 - Is the differing dependent-entity check for deletion — Building blocked by *any floor* (FR-022) vs. Floor/Equipment Type blocked by *any referencing room* (FR-016, FR-022) — explicitly justified, or could a reviewer read it as an unintentional inconsistency between the three catalogs? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, FR-022]
- [x] CHK006 - Are deactivate/reactivate semantics symmetric across the three catalogs, or are Building/Floor's cascade rules (FR-021) an intentional, documented exception to the otherwise-independent Equipment Type deactivation (FR-014)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, FR-021]
- [x] CHK007 - Does a functional requirement state whether a Floor can be reactivated while its parent Building remains deactivated, or is this rule only implied by the API contract's 409 response and absent from the spec's FRs? [Consistency, Gap, Spec §FR-021 vs contracts/openapi.yaml]
- [x] CHK008 - Is the term "remove" used with a single, consistent meaning (deactivate vs. hard-delete) across FR-016, FR-021, and FR-022, or could its dual usage there be misread? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-016, FR-021, FR-022]
- [x] CHK009 - Do the Key Entities descriptions for Equipment Type, Building, and Floor (spec.md) state their deactivation/visibility-on-existing-references behavior in matching language, so a reader cannot infer the three catalogs behave differently when they don't? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK010 - Is "belongs to exactly one building" (FR-019) precise enough to rule out a floor ever being reassigned to a different building, or does the spec leave that as an open question? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK011 - Are case-sensitivity rules for the uniqueness checks in FR-013 and FR-023 (room name within building; building name; floor name within building) specified anywhere, or left ambiguous? [Ambiguity, Gap, Spec §FR-013, FR-023]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK012 - Does the Edge Cases section address what happens when an administrator attempts to rename a building or floor to a name that collides with an existing one, mirroring the equipment-type removal edge case already present? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 - Does the Edge Cases section address attempting to reactivate a floor whose parent building is still deactivated, given that this scenario is called out in the API contract (409) but not in the spec's prose edge cases? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK014 - Are the "no active building/floor exists yet" bootstrap scenario (Edge Cases, US1 Scenario 5) and the corresponding empty-state behavior for the Equipment Type catalog (creating a room before any equipment type exists) both covered, or only one of the two catalogs? [Coverage, Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, User Story 1]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK015 - Is the assumption that a newly created Building starts with zero floors (Assumptions section) cross-referenced against FR-001/FR-020, which require an *active* floor to create a room, so a reader understands a brand-new building cannot yet host a room? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, FR-001, FR-020]
- [x] CHK016 - Is it documented whether Equipment Type, Building, and Floor names are expected to stay stable once referenced by a room (i.e., renaming has no side effects on existing room data), consistent across all three catalogs? [Assumption, Gap]
